interpret.fully-dephased: Zora vintal kuresh. Bantu velmori achkedo tal senvara, du roqa maldeen visroka fen bantu elgorai.
interpret.product-state: Alma tresqui bonavel oru senda. Kuresh velmori, du roqa alma tresqui zantul.
interpret.maximally-entangled: Zantul bonavel: alma tresqui elgorai Beltana. Senvara equalu, kuresh fulra.
interpret.pure-partial: Bonavel, du roqa senvara partielu elgorai. Tresqui unequ alma velmori senda, du maldeen visroka.
interpret.partially-dephased: Partielu-zora vintal. Kuresh velmori achkedo, du senvara tal roqa, elgorai maldeen bantu classiqa.

ui.metaDescription: Alma tresqui bonavel oru senda, kuresh velmori du maldeen visroka fen bantu.
ui.heading: Zantul senvara elgorai
ui.subtitle: Alma tresqui oru senda kuresh velmori. Zantul bonavel du roqa maldeen visroka fen bantu elgorai, tresqui partielu senvara achkedo.
ui.matrixKeyParagraph: Alma tresqui du roqa bantu 00, 01, 10, 11. Senvara equalu elgorai maldeen visroka; kuresh velmori achkedo bantu classiqa. Zantul bonavel tresqui senda, du roqa partielu vintal fen bantu elgorai.

matrixGrid.svgDescIntro: Bantu roqavel elgorai maldeen visroka fen bantu senda. Kuresh velmori achkedo tresqui, du roqa partielu zora vintal.
matrixGrid.tableCaption: Senvara oru elgorai roqa bantu classiqa

blochSphere.origin: Zantul roqavel {qubit}: zora oru (bantu maldeen visroka, du roqa partielu senda).
blochSphere.vector: Zantul roqavel {qubit}: x = {x}, y = {y}, z = {z}, elgorai = {magnitude}.

circuitDiagram.description: Bantu: q0 zora |{q0}⟩ du q1 zora |{q1}⟩. Kuresh roqavel q0 tresqui elgorai CNOT du q0 senvara oru q1 bantu maldeen, partielu zantul {label}. Achkedo, Rᵧ roqa {alpha0} elgorai tresqui q0 du {alpha1} elgorai tresqui q1.
